scope: Five seeds on 12 practice photos; 240 explanations. Initial pilot excluded from pooled counts.
findings: All 15 tasks have completion markers and correct seed identities; all stderr logs are empty. All recorded guidance steps are finite.
The same four practice photos per class pair were used across arms and seeds. There are 12 distinct photos, not 60 independent photos.
Exact evaluator success is 10/60 versus shortcut 12/60 for jump1, and 9/60 versus 11/60 for jump4. Each paired comparison has 3 gains and 5 losses.

The original jump4/exact seed-0 cheetah corruption and 183 update spike did not reproduce. However, visually corrupted jump1/exact cheetah edits occur in the seed-0 repeat and seed 1, with maximum update norms 53.78 and 38.22 respectively. All ten cheetah/exact grids were inspected.
Pooled image-change and perceptual distances are higher for exact than shortcut in both jump counts.

The seed-0 repeat changes evaluator predictions in all pairs except zebra jump4/exact; even shortcut outputs and some guide success outcomes change. Early losses begin identical, then small gradient differences grow. Numerical nondeterminism is a plausible contributor, not an established sole cause. Recorded metadata does not include code or weight hashes.
Zebra-to-sorrel has 0/20 evaluator successes in every arm. Preserve this observation rather than dropping the pair based on pilot performance.
Maximum allocated memory remains 8.83 GiB at batch one. There is no demonstrated need to increase batch size for feasibility.
recommendation: Before held-out experiments, add a strict reproducibility mode (deterministic algorithms, cuDNN settings, cuBLAS workspace configuration, TF32 disabled) and record its settings plus code and weight identities. Perform one small identical seed-0 run twice on the same GPU model/software configuration. Diagnose unsupported deterministic operations explicitly. Preserve the raw-gradient primary comparison; any norm-matched experiment must be a separately defined sensitivity comparison. Do not rerun all seeds simply to seek a positive H2 result.
